summary.name: EmptyRoom AI
summary.one_liner: A web tool that virtually stages, restages, empties and enhances real estate listing photos, either imported from Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin or Trulia links or uploaded by the user.
use_cases: Staging a vacant listing's photos before it goes on the market
Removing a seller's furniture from listing photos
Trying several decor styles on one room
Building a walkthrough video from staged photos
summary.what_it_does: Users paste a link from Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin or Trulia, or upload their own photos, and the tool imports the images. Each room can be staged in one of 14 named styles (such as Modern, Scandinavian, Mid-Century Modern, Coastal and Luxury), or emptied or decluttered. Architecture such as walls, windows, trim and flooring is said to be kept fixed. Restaging a room is unlimited after the first charge, and downloads are listed as free and full resolution. Staged photos can be reordered and assembled into a walkthrough video with set hold times, transitions and a music bed.
notable: Imports listings directly from Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin and Trulia links
14 selectable staging styles, with unlimited restages of a room once paid
Turns staged photos into a walkthrough video with transitions and music
Per-room pricing starting at $4.00 on the Brokerage plan
caveats: Paid plans only: Solo $49.99/mo, Studio $149.99/mo, Brokerage $499.99/mo, with credits per room (10 credits per room) that reset each period and do not roll over
Page states most MLSs require virtually staged photos to be labelled as such
Bulk staging and priority support are listed only on the higher-tier plans
